title: WP-T4, WP-T5 and WP-T6 TEAT frontends: governed contracts and provisioning, Android/mobile and web UI/workflow homologation, with productive operation deferred

batches.headline: Reconciled TEAT corpus and source contracts, integrated in PR #70.
Frontend parity contracts and governed preflight, integrated in PR #73.
Offline operational provisioning and authoritative backend boundaries, integrated in PR #82.
ADR-0033 mobile/web UI and workflow homologation, six AIT REDs resolved, full manifest and synthetic workflow proofs, production negatives, documentation and issues #108–#112; integrated in PR #113.

delivery-review.detail: Independent Owner-authorized same-family Codex reviewer PASS on exact Git tree bba592ecf0750f4da0525c990668dc16b5cb0d18; no blockers. Earlier group reviews and corrective cycles remain in the round records.

github-ci.detail: PR #113 seven checks passed on the integrated candidate: backend-kernel, foundation, boat-documents-real, evidence-gate, senatran-mock, senatran-mock-tests and verified-local-rc. Earlier PRs #70, #73 and #82 were merged under their gates.

pnpm-check.detail: Full local pnpm check exited 0 on the reviewed candidate, including formatting, orchestration, knowledge base, blueprints, contracts, generated consistency, typechecks, lint, frontend tests and builds.

app-suite.detail: Mobile 1157/1157 and web 594/594; independent focused DOM/a11y review mobile 32/32 and web 29/29, including six former AIT REDs, 576 indexed transitions and 197 denied conditionals.

evidence-chain.detail: DEVAI generic evidence through sequence 15, chain valid; audit observation EV-33ead2fd8120f724 records exact PR #113 merge 646c6c2897f1dff275ebe513dfa15f62d5a2befb.

validation_criteria.criterion: The six AIT REDs are resolved through explicit homologation-only positive paths while productive missing-authority negatives remain fail-closed.
validation_criteria.evidence: PR #113; ADR-0033; mobile suite 1157/1157; independent review PASS on exact tree.

validation_criteria.criterion: Mobile and web homologation demonstrate the governed routes, guards, forms, AIT, sync, roles, synthetic events, error states and accessibility without real IdP, official AIT, network side effects or field rights.
validation_criteria.evidence: PR #113; mobile 1157/1157, web 594/594; reviewer mobile 32/32 and web 29/29; full pnpm check and CI green.

validation_criteria.criterion: The Owner-approved equipment decision does not imply homologation of the productive app or field operation; productive E2 trust, validator, lifecycle, device integration and release are separately tracked.
validation_criteria.evidence: ADR-0033; build pack and round plan; open GitHub issues #108–#112.

validation_criteria.criterion: All delivered commits are PR-integrated, the final merge is audited by exact SHA, and the DEVAI evidence chain verifies.
validation_criteria.evidence: PRs #70, #73, #82 and #113; merge 646c6c2897f1dff275ebe513dfa15f62d5a2befb; EV-33ead2fd8120f724; evidence verify head 510f34f0c5961e30b2d4c0a5402fcab76b9baea1c628dd1ee2f9b3d01571009d.

notes: D-1 is the Owner-authorized R-0013 orchestration. D-2 closes only the delivered UI/workflow homologation scope under the Owner decision of 2026-09-23, not productive TEAT mobile/field operation. The Gertec GMS820 equipment approval remains unconditional, but productive app integration needs a separate round (R-0017 is only a candidate ID). Production issues #108–#112 stay open. No package release or deployment is authorized or implied.
